 I CONCUR with Tan Sri Lee Lam Thye’s proposals in “Flood mitigation systems in KL need an overhaul” (The Star, Nov 9; https://tinyurl.com/33txmm98).
 The most urgent task for Kuala Lumpur City Hall (DBKL) is to quickly review the Kuala Lumpur Urban Drainage Master Plan within the context of the integrated management of the Klang River Basin, and taking into consideration the proposed urban drainage plans by other local authorities within Klang Valley.
